messages.author: 565a91867a539265
messages.subject: log1p and expm1 in nimble????
parts:
Hello,

I was wondering if there is anything equivalent to log1p and expm1 R functions in Nimble. 

I am using the exp and the log functions but they return NAs since the are not very accurate. (e.g. exp(x) - 1  for |x| << 1)


Many thanks,
Nick

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: log1p and expm1 in nimble????
parts: Per Table 11.2 in the user manual, log1p is supported.  expm1 is not supported but could be added in the future.
